item_name: Rothco Touch Screen Gloves With Gripper Dots
item_short_desc: The Rothco Touch Screen Gloves With Gripper Dots are the perfect gloves for cold weather mobile phone use. The formfitting gloves are covered in gripper dots and feature touch screen application on the index fingers and thumbs for compatibility with cell phones. No need to take of your gloves in the cold weather to send a text message or answer your phone.
